es: Usar alternativas a if para poner condiciones y advertir sobre consecuencias en una situación real.

teaching.en: We will go to the coast unless it rains all week.
teaching.es: Iremos a la costa a menos que llueva toda la semana.
teaching.explanationEs: Unless significa «si no»: va con un verbo afirmativo en presente.
segments: We will go to the coast
teaching.audioText: We will go to the coast unless it rains all week.

teaching.en: We can rent the house provided that everyone pays a deposit.
teaching.es: Podemos alquilar la casa siempre que todos paguen un depósito.
teaching.explanationEs: Provided that significa «solo si»: es una condición imprescindible.
segments: We can rent the house provided
teaching.audioText: We can rent the house provided that everyone pays a deposit.

teaching.en: Book the tickets today; otherwise, the price will go up.
teaching.es: Reserva las entradas hoy; de lo contrario, subirá el precio.
teaching.explanationEs: Otherwise advierte de la consecuencia de no hacer algo; va en una frase nueva.
teaching.audioText: Book the tickets today; otherwise, the price will go up.

teaching.en: I agree, provided that we keep to the budget.
teaching.es: Estoy de acuerdo, siempre que respetemos el presupuesto.
teaching.explanationEs: Provided that + sujeto + presente: la condición que pones para aceptar.
teaching.audioText: I agree, provided that we keep to the budget.

teaching.en: I wish we had saved more; we cannot afford the hotel now.
teaching.es: Ojalá hubiéramos ahorrado más; ahora no podemos permitirnos el hotel.
teaching.explanationEs: I wish + had + participio lamenta algo pasado y explica el problema de hoy.

we cannot afford the hotel now.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase significa «iremos, a menos que llueva»?

choices.text: We will go unless it does not rain.
We will go unless it rains.
We will go provided that it rains.

feedback.es: Unless equivale a if not, así que no lleva otra negación. La segunda invierte el sentido y la tercera pone una condición contraria.

hint.es: Unless equivale a if not: no lleva otra negación.

feedback.es: Provided that significa «siempre que»: solo vengo si pagas. Even if y in case no expresan una condición imprescindible.

prompt.es: Responde a tus amigos sobre el viaje, de 60 a 120 palabras.

answer.text: I wish we had booked the tickets earlier, because now they are expensive. We can still go to the coast provided that we share the cost of the hotel. We will stay three nights unless the weather is terrible. Please send me the deposit today; otherwise, we will lose the room. I will pay the rest, provided that everyone agrees to the plan. Tell me what you think about it, and answer me soon!
accepted: I wish we had booked the tickets earlier, because now they are expensive. We can still go to the coast provided that we share the cost of the hotel. We will stay three nights unless the weather is terrible. Please send me the deposit today; otherwise, we will lose the room. I will pay the rest, provided that everyone agrees to the plan. Tell me what you think about it, and answer me soon!

I wish we had saved more money for this trip. We can still go to the lake provided that everyone pays a small deposit. We will sleep there in a tent unless it rains a lot. Please answer me today; otherwise, I will give your place to someone else. I agree to pay for the food, provided that you choose a cheap hotel. What do you think?

feedback.es: El mensaje integra el arrepentimiento con I wish, las condiciones con unless y provided that, y la advertencia con otherwise.

origin.text: Tus amigos preguntan por el viaje. Responde con: un arrepentimiento (I wish we had…), dos condiciones (una con unless y otra con provided that) y una advertencia con otherwise.
